tailoring.headline: Senior E-Commerce Technical Architect – SAP Commerce Cloud & Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering large-scale e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in headless, B2C/B2B commerce, REST/OCC APIs, microservices, cloud deployments, and end-to-end PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven record designing technical architecture, leading API migrations, and driving Agile delivery while bridging business and IT with AI-assisted analysis and documentation.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior SFCC B2C Technical Architect – Mirakl Marketplace
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Ann Huerta’s vision to build a best-in-class Mirakl marketplace on Salesforce Commerce Cloud. With 5+ years leading SAP Commerce Cloud architecture at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in headless B2C commerce, API design, and large-scale integrations that align perfectly with your technical challenges.

bullets.label: Technical Architecture
bullets.text: Designed end-to-end technical solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud, defining data models, microservice layers and deployment strategies that ensured scalability and performance.

bullets.label: API Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST web services and orchestrated PIM-ERP-MDM pipelines, delivering seamless product and customer data flows across global channels.

bullets.label: Headless Commerce
bullets.text: Implemented headless, B2C-focused APIs and PWA integrations, enabling flexible storefront experiences and rapid time-to-market for new features.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery
bullets.text: Led cross-functional, international teams in Agile sprints, using CI/CD pipelines, AI-assisted analysis and rigorous code reviews to accelerate delivery cycles.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

tailoring.why_company: Ann Huerta’s focus on creating a cutting-edge Mirakl marketplace within SFCC aligns with my passion for building scalable, headless e-commerce ecosystems. I am eager to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to accelerate your integration roadmap, bring AI-driven efficiency, and help deliver a seamless B2C experience for your clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud architecture experience to drive innovative SFCC marketplace solutions at Ann Huerta.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior e-commerce architect with 5+ years on SAP Commerce Cloud. I’m keen to bring my integration and headless expertise to your SFCC Mirakl project. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Senior SFCC B2C Technical Architect – Mirakl Marketplace
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior SFCC B2C Technical Architect role. With 5+ years of senior SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am ready to contribute to your Mirakl marketplace initiative.

I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with your needs.
